messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — P1: elevated 5xx spike observed on gw-prod. Error rate up ~8% for last 3m. Affected path: /v1/generate. Paging on-call: @maya-oncall. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ingress/errors (summary + top traces)

maya-oncall: jumping in, joining call now.

maya-oncall: region breakdown? correlate ids? first seen ~14:22 UTC from SLO alerts.

ken-runtime: looks concentrated in us-east-1, mainly POST /v1/generate. Gateway showing 502/504 with upstream timeouts and a few retry loops. example log line:
```
time=2026-03-17T14:22:31Z level=error service=gateway req_id=corr=abcd1234 upstream=10.2.6.7:8080 error="upstream timeout" retries=2
```

carla-sre: pulling traces now. did we have any model-serving deploys around 14:15-14:20? also pls dump KV cache hit/miss counters.

dan-eng: no deploys in that window from prod team. sharing short gateway log sample to S3 (link below).

dan-eng: ```
[14:21:55] gw: recv req corr=abcd1234 path=/v1/generate
[14:22:01] gw->upstream 10.2.6.7: timeout (15s)
[14:22:02] gw retrying req corr=abcd1234 (retry=1)
[14:22:16] gw->upstream 10.2.6.7: 502 Bad Gateway
```

erin-support: CS report: 4 distinct enterprise customers reported degraded/failed calls in last 10m. Raising incidents for top 3. CCing account reps. :loud_sound:

maya-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) route subset traffic in us-east to model-smaller variant for 10m, 2) apply stricter retry backoff at gateway to avoid amplification, 3) collect full traces+kv logs. Applying route change now.

deploy-bot: Action applied: route-update r-9987 -> us-east: redirect 30% of /v1/generate -> model-smaller, TTL=10m (initiated by @maya-oncall).

ken-runtime: after route change error rate dropped to ~2.1% (from 8%), still some tails. KV cache shows elevated prefix misses for popular prompts (miss rate spike +45%). hypothesis: upstream worker saturation => increased latencies => retries => amplified 5xx.

carla-sre: live timeline (working):
- 14:15–14:20: normal
- 14:21: first backend latency spikes seen in traces
- 14:22: alert fired (elevated 5xx)
- 14:28: route fallback applied
- 14:30: partial recovery, error rate down but not fully stable
Attaching sample correlation ids for traces: corr=abcd1234, corr=ef56gh78, corr=zz9900yy

dan-eng: additional hypothesis: infra tail from GC/OOM-kicks on a subset of on-prem model workers in us-east. checking node-level metrics (heap, GC pause) now. running: `kubectl top pods -n model-us-east | grep worker`

maya-oncall: please upload full request dumps for the corr ids above to the incident S3 and share links here. erin, can you coordinate customer consent for full request data?

erin-support: on it — DMing legal for consent, reaching out to affected accounts now and opening tickets. will post consent/status in thread.

ken-runtime: uploaded logs bundle: https://s3.redwood.example/incident-2967123456/gateway-logs-2967123456.gz (gz contains lines with `corr=` prefix). also pushed trace bundle to https://s3.redwood.example/incident-2967123456/traces-2967123456.jsonl

carla-sre: next actions: 1) run synthetic load against us-east frontend to reproduce tails, 2) add temporary per-customer qps caps to reduce retries, 3) collect full heap/GC traces from suspect model workers, 4) prepare RCA checklist. I will own mitigation checklist.

maya-oncall: thanks. assigning action items: ken -> full trace analysis + log correlation, carla -> mitigation checklist + synthetic test, dan -> infra metrics+node dumps, erin -> customer comms/legal. I'll keep leading until handoff. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 2967123456 status updated: mitigations applied, monitoring. Next update in 15m or on request.
